hooks.name: Never ignore the .kiro directory
hooks.description: Fails loudly if .gitignore ever lists .kiro, which would disqualify the hackathon submission.

action.command: f=$(find . -maxdepth 2 -name .gitignore -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head -5); if grep -nE '^\s*/?\.kiro' $f 2>/dev/null; then echo 'ERROR: .gitignore ignores .kiro. The hackathon requires /.kiro to be committed. Remove that line.' >&2; exit 1; else echo '.gitignore OK: .kiro is tracked'; fi
